game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables, the sleigh stables: the hold guard must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against winter bandits.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables: the sleigh stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Sleigh Stables, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against winter bandits. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about spells to power up the hold guard and open the chapel bell.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sleigh Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Sleigh Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
